title: Receipt
description: The signed record correlating a Decision to what actually happened.

attempted.description: Whether execution was attempted after the Decision.

completed_at.description: When the outcome was recorded (Unix seconds).

signer.description: Actor id of the enforcement or observation point.

execution_validation_ref.description: Optional id of the Execution Validation Record (Spec 30 §4, schemas/execution-validation-record.schema.json) that preceded this Receipt's dispatch, if the PEP performed that check. Not a kernel field — an optional Core-format correlation, absent when Execution-Time Authorization Validation (Spec 30) was not performed.
